biggest_catch: Microtasks pay cents each with employer-controlled approval — rejected work pays nothing with no recourse — and the first payout is slow (a PIN is physically mailed to your address for verification), plus PayPal takes a 7.5% fee, so small balances shrink fast.
catches: First withdrawal requires a PIN mailed to your physical address to verify it — expect 3-6 weeks for the first payout; subsequent withdrawals are faster.
Minimum withdrawal: $9 + fees (PayPal fee 7.50%; Skrill/Dwolla 6.50%; Transpay 3.00% + $1/$3; Payoneer $20 + 5.00%) — all from the official FAQ.
Employers approve or reject your submitted work (auto-approval after 168 hours); rejected work is unpaid with no recourse — one of the most common complaints.
Only earned income is withdrawable; deposits can only be refunded to their original payment source.
Tasks often pay a few cents for 10-15 minutes of work; hourly rate is very low for most users.

steps: Create a free Microworkers account with your email and password.
Browse the Jobs list and pick microtasks (surveys, data entry, app testing, social tasks) — check the pay, rating, and time-to-rate before starting.
Complete the task exactly per instructions and submit the required proof.
Wait for employer approval (or automatic approval after 168 hours); approved pay is credited to your balance.
Before your first withdrawal, verify your address with the PIN Microworkers mails to you (expect a few weeks).
Once your balance reaches $9 + fees, go to the Withdraw tab, place a withdrawal request, and choose PayPal, Skrill, Transpay, or Payoneer.
timing: First payout: 3-6 weeks (address PIN verification); later withdrawals faster. Minimum $9 + fees ($20 + 5% for Payoneer).
